environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: hopset plus client tokens controls what is forwarded, and the conditional re-add fires on any POST, so Connection: content-length is a no-op on framing while range/if-none-match/accept-encoding/authorization remain attacker-deletable and observable (304 to 200).
findings.title: All five client-nominated headers are deletable; framing is re-added so the POST desync cannot fire

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
